about.text: A traditional fermented mare's milk of Mongolia and Inner Mongolia, soured and lightly alcoholic by spontaneous fermentation with lactic bacteria and yeasts, closely related to airag.

links.name: Food Sci. Nutr. (2020), 188 Xilin Gol samples; Table 2

facts.v: Falls from 6.95 % in the milk to 2.82 % when soured
Raw milk cooled and filtered, mixed with leftover product or a starter, and left 1 to 2 days at 20 to 25 °C
Protein 2.1 %, fat 0.8 %, alcohol 0.5 % in the Xilin Gol samples
